_about: Public-domain Jeremy Taylor (1613-1667, Anglican divine, Bishop of Down and Connor) for the Word Hoard: Holy Living and Holy Dying clean from CCEL, and the Whole Works (London: Longman, 1847-54, 10 vols, Heber's edition revised by Charles Page Eden) as raw Internet Archive OCR from Toronto scans. Not Bayard Taylor (lane C's translator shelf) or any other Taylor. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 8 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
